title: TREE Arcade session return: runtime participation diagnosis

findings.finding: The Daily Growth browser sign-in and TREE FORCE game session are separate credentials.
evidence: scripts/arcade-daily-growth.js: createDailyGrowth/sessionStorage default and restore/focus handlers
play/index.html: growth-play target=_blank with noopener noreferrer
treeforce89/frontend/NFTreeGateway.tsx: own sessionRef and first-wave participation reporter
treeforce89/frontend/participation-client.mjs: POST treeforce-play with game bearer and runId only
findings.implication: A successful first-wave report records progress without a Daily Growth lobby token. New-tab wallet restoration and stale lobby data independently explain the apparent sign-out/status problem.

findings.finding: The published participation reader lacks its required runtime database binding.
evidence: netlify/lib/arcade-treeforce-session.ts: configuredQuery requires TREEFORCE89_DEV_DATABASE_URL before any SQL
netlify/functions/arcade-growth.ts: treeforce-play validates the game bearer through that reader before ownership or participation RPC
scripts/release-treeforce-participation.mjs: original helper injected the binding per deploy
scripts/release-daily-growth-quest-layout.py: later helper omitted per-deploy environment overrides
production/arcade-session-return-baseline.json: 49 persistent function records, zero shared functions, no target binding
findings.implication: An absent binding directly produces HTTP503 participation-unavailable before the session SELECT. Preserving the existing49 persistent entries did not preserve the originally per-deployment binding.

findings.finding: A recorded first-wave event writes its check-in and quest together.
evidence: supabase/migrations/20261031220110_arcade_growth_treeforce_participation.sql: event/check-in/quest/badges and idempotent original UTC date
findings.implication: Existing successful records remain durable. A503 report has no event to display; signing back into the lobby cannot fabricate missing gameplay evidence. A pending report can retry only with its matching unexpired game session/run.

observedFailedRequests.provenance: Root agent sanitized live Netlify request-log inspection; no request headers, signatures, wallet addresses, or tokens retained
observedFailedRequests.qualification: Logs establish503 responses, not a particular user or wallet. The inspected missing binding explains the same failure path; do not claim attribution of these requests to the reporting user.

recordedParticipationAggregate.provenance: Root agent read-only Supabase aggregate; agent did not query or alter individual user rows
recordedParticipationAggregate.qualification: Successful historical event reconciliation is intact; the aggregate does not identify which run the reporting user played.
